snippet.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Empire City | Gameplay Trailer | VR
snippet.description:
Get behind the bandana as the iconic heroes in a half shell, stalking the sewers, streets, and rooftops as Leonardo, Raphael, Donatello, or Michelangelo in the first-ever Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles that takes YOU inside the shell.

Forge your own chapter in TMNT legacy solo, or with up to three friends. Hone your skills with the brothers’ signature weapons and slash, swing, and stab your way through combat as you land precision strikes, block crushing reprisals, and evade the killing blow.

Coming in 2026. Wishlist now!

👉 Meta Quest: https://vr.meta.me/s/1L2KRVYie9Nqfgj
👉 SteamVR: https://bit.ly/3ZbZwLR
